title: K-07 TOCTOU：每次校验都用当前解析结果，第二次解析到内网即拒绝（残余风险见报告）

cases.name: revalidate
cases.code:
import sys, json
sys.path.insert(0, 'scripts')
import identity_check as ic
calls = []
def resolver(host, port, *a, **k):
    calls.append(host)
    if len(calls) > 1:
        return [(2, 1, 6, '', ('10.0.0.5', 0))]
    return [(2, 1, 6, '', ('93.184.216.34', 0))]
try:
    ic.validate_url('https://example.com/', resolver=resolver)
    ic.validate_url('https://example.com/', resolver=resolver)
    print(json.dumps({'status': 'ok', 'calls': len(calls)}))
except ic.UnsafeUrl as exc:
    print(json.dumps({'status': 'unsafe', 'reason': exc.reason, 'calls': len(calls)}))
